provenance.steps: Hand construction from REG-1 Table 3 with t = k/12 years and each upper bound inclusive (M17). CONTRACT MTG_FIX EUR pays scheduled principal of k currency units in month k at every upper bound (k = 1, 3, 6, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36, ..., 120, 180, 240) and the month after it, and at k = 300, with interest of 1 in every month, outside the gap: k = 1 is bucket 2, k = 3 bucket 3 (1/12 < t <= 3/12), k = 240 bucket 18, k = 241 bucket 19. Bucket sums add the two months of each bucket, e.g. bucket 3: 2 + 3 = 5; the total is 2,551, the opening balance. Bucket 1 (overnight) is empty on the monthly grid. CONTRACT MTG_RST EUR: a RESET loan in its fixed period, scheduled 5 at k = 12 and k = 24, fixed until month 30 and maturing in month 300, places its balance of 490 as repricing principal in the bucket of month 30 (bucket 9, 2 < t <= 3), not in the maturity bucket 19. CONTRACT MTG_FLT EUR: a FLOAT loan with its next reset in month 3, an upper bound, maturing in month 180, places 300 in bucket 3, not bucket 17. BASE MTG_FIX EUR: prepaid principal 100 in month 9 (bucket 5) and scheduled 900 in month 240 (bucket 18).
